scope: Existing customer/contact/product import and serialization of existing PowerOffice sync jobs; not a full historical replica.
ownerDecision: A full replacement of PowerOffice remains undecided; existing capabilities and outbound integration are retained.

unitArchitectureInputs.onlyPostRunDifference: Integration-test collection annotation; final normal build and SQL run include it.

regressions: HTTP 503 or null page before cursor publication
Same-source entity creation before failed link commit, including contacts without e-mail
Concurrent import of the same source key
Killed or reopened SQL session cannot publish unlocked cursor
Existing PowerOffice outbound and Billing scenarios
checkpoint: Last fully completed stream cursor; interrupted range is safely reread, not resumed by mutable page number.

firstCombinedRun.corrections: Fixture cursor isolation and CAST of SQL session ID; no assertion/deadline relaxed.

notClaimed: Account switching or multiple PowerOffice companies
Complete upstream snapshot or arbitrary late-change coverage
A new global outbound replica-mode gate
